blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The LEA frequently asks about the minimum standards under BP 220 and PD 957. These are specific numbers — minimum lot sizes, minimum road right-of-way widths, minimum open space percentages. Memorize the key figures for each housing category (socialized, economic, low-cost, medium-cost, open market).</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Callout>The Comprehensive Land Use Plan (CLUP) is one of the most important planning instruments in the Philippine system. Every LGU is required to prepare one. It classifies land into zones (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, etc.) and is the legal basis for the Zoning Ordinance. Understanding the CLUP process — who prepares it, who approves it, how long it is valid — is regularly tested.</Callout>
